intro.name: Scholar:
intro.text: That scythe… Could it be? No--

intro.name: Scholar:
intro.text: Hello traveler, welcome to Solunaris. It’s been a while since anybody has passed through here.

intro.name: Scholar:
intro.text: I apologize for the sorry state of this place but... you’re welcome to take a look around.

destruction.name: Scholar:
destruction.text: You have progressed along the path of destruction.

destruction.name: Scholar:
destruction.text: Is this truly the path you chose to follow? Tread carefully.

destruction.name: Scholar:
destruction.text: Perhaps some things are best left forgotten.

restoration.name: Scholar:
restoration.text: You have progressed along the path of restoration.

restoration.name: Scholar:
restoration.text: Is this truly the path you chose to follow? Tread carefully.

restoration.name: Scholar:
restoration.text: Perhaps there is hope for this kingdom yet.

neutral.name: Scholar:
neutral.text: You walk a delicate balance traveller.

academy-destroyed.name: Scholar:
academy-destroyed.text: So the Solunaris Academy was destroyed… I used to teach there, you know.

academy-destroyed.name: Scholar:
academy-destroyed.text: Oh well… It’s probably for the best– Some things there are best left forgotten.

academy-rebuilt.name: Scholar:
academy-rebuilt.text: I couldn’t help but notice the Solunaris Academy has been rebuilt.

academy-rebuilt.name: Scholar:
academy-rebuilt.text: The Academy was renowned around the world for its prestige and the opportunities it provided for all.

academy-rebuilt.name: Scholar:
academy-rebuilt.text: Maybe I can even return to my office there.

farm-destroyed.name: Scholar:
farm-destroyed.text: The Alder’s farm was the largest in the kingdom.

farm-destroyed.name: Scholar:
farm-destroyed.text: When their crops fell ill and the little they had went to the palace… I fear that was the beginning of the end for Solunaris.

farm-rebuilt.name: Scholar:
farm-rebuilt.text: The Alder’s farm was the largest in the kingdom.

farm-rebuilt.name: Scholar:
farm-rebuilt.text: I hope that life can return to the fields and once again provide grain to all of Solunaris’s people.

cookhouse-destroyed.name: Scholar:
cookhouse-destroyed.text: Good to see the cookhouse in a pile of rubble.

cookhouse-destroyed.name: Scholar:
cookhouse-destroyed.text: I remember so many blurred faces waiting in line with nothing but a faint hope for food in their hearts… only to get none in return.

cookhouse-rebuilt.name: Scholar:
cookhouse-rebuilt.text: In the Kingdom’s prime, the Solunaris Cookhouse served food to all her people, commoners and nobles alike.

cookhouse-rebuilt.name: Scholar:
cookhouse-rebuilt.text: Maybe those days will come again soon.

church-destroyed.name: Scholar:
church-destroyed.text: The people of Solunaris were never quite religious, but the few who were were all crazed fanatics.

church-destroyed.name: Scholar:
church-destroyed.text: They worshipped a deity that would bring ruin to this kingdom.

church-destroyed.name: Scholar:
church-destroyed.text: Now I think maybe they had a point.

church-rebuilt.name: Scholar:
church-rebuilt.text: I never was religious myself, but I admired those who were.

church-rebuilt.name: Scholar:
church-rebuilt.text: They worshiped a deity who would one day pass judgment on Solunaris’s people.

church-rebuilt.name: Scholar:
church-rebuilt.text: Come to think of it…  the depiction in the stained glass looked a bit familiar.

theatre-destroyed.name: Scholar:
theatre-destroyed.text: People went to the theater to escape reality but when things went dark and the palace shut its doors, all their shows turned to tragedies.

theatre-destroyed.name: Scholar:
theatre-destroyed.text: It was a very bleak affair.

theatre-destroyed.name: Scholar:
theatre-destroyed.text: The theater was no longer an escape… only a mirror.

theatre-rebuilt.name: Scholar:
theatre-rebuilt.text: The Eclipse Theater was the main attraction in Solunaris.

theatre-rebuilt.name: Scholar:
theatre-rebuilt.text: Travelers from all over would come to watch their acclaimed performances and all were welcome.

theatre-rebuilt.name: Scholar:
theatre-rebuilt.text: Now that it has been rebuilt, I would love to see a show again sometime.

castle-destroyed.name: Scholar:
castle-destroyed.text: Looks like we will be living forever in hell.

prison-destroyed.name: Scholar:
prison-destroyed.text: Looks like we will remain a crime-ridden place.

library-rebuilt.name: Scholar:
library-rebuilt.text: Centuries of knowledge has been restored.
